QUOTE: "Without it, `sanitizeReactions` would also return every stored reaction on the post that is absent from `rawReactions` as `deleteReactions`. Since `rawReactions` holds only the one new reaction, every other reaction on the post would be deleted."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer explains that skipSync prevents the single incoming reaction from being treated as the full set, which would delete all other reactions on the post.
